name: covariate_construction_monthly_public_infrastructure_spending
citation: FRED (US Census, BLS, Federal Reserve, IMF, LBMA)
license: public domain / FRED terms of use
description: c3-infra-spending — 'Public construction spending' forecasting bundle. Native cadence monthly; 401 timesteps 1993-01-01..2026-05-01. Non-EIA sources. Known-future covariates: IIJA highway apportionment. NO contemporaneous covariates — all covariates enter as past values only; known-future covariates (weather forecasts, scheduled budgets/releases) are genuinely available at forecast time. Timestamp-derived calendar features are NOT included — time information is carried only by the timestamps column.
preprocessing: 1. curl FRED fredgraph.csv per series (plain UA + --http1.1; browser UA triggers HTTP/2 reset)
3. resample to month-start mean (weekly MORTGAGE30US and daily DTWEXBGS/GOLDAMGBD228NLBM -> monthly mean; monthly series unchanged)

4. Renamed raw source fields to human-readable (FRED series ID -> column): TLPBLCONS->Public construction spending, GS10->10-year Treasury yield, USCONS->Construction employment, WPUSI012011->Construction materials PPI, IPG3273S->Cement and concrete output, PERMIT->Building permits.
5. inner-join covariates on month-start index ; derive IIJA highway apportionment from FHWA FY2022-2026 contract authority

8. Reformatted wide -> TempusBench long (variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps, values); variable names are human-readable English; timestamp-derived calendar features dropped (time lives only in the timestamps column); timestamps ISO-8601 UTC-labelled, shared across variables; missing -> null; CSV-writer quoted.
